en: Revenue of $40.2B (+34% in dollars) hit the top of guidance, and gross margin of 67.7% and operating margin of 60.3% both beat the guided ranges; net profit rose 77%, helped by a one-off gain on Vanguard shares. The Q3 guide is $44.6–45.8B, with gross margin easing to 65–67% as 2nm and overseas fabs ramp. TSMC raised its full-year growth outlook and lifted 2026 capex to $60–64B, and CFO Wendell Huang said capex over the next three years will be even more significantly higher than the past three.

The ADR fell 2.3% on the day and about 5% by the next close, as the bigger capex bill and softer Q3 margins outweighed the beat. Late-July's chip selloff took it to $375 on Jul 29, about 11% below the pre-report close. It then climbed steadily as AI demand held up, reaching a high near $486 in early October, and remains about 8% above the pre-report level.
zh: 营收 402 亿美元（以美元计 +34%）达到指引上限，毛利率 67.7%、营业利润率 60.3% 均高于指引区间；净利润增长 77%，部分得益于出售世界先进股票的一次性收益。第三季指引营收 446–458 亿美元，毛利率因 2 纳米和海外晶圆厂爬坡降至 65–67%。台积电上调全年增长展望，并将 2026 年资本开支提高至 600–640 亿美元；CFO 黄仁昭表示未来三年资本开支将比过去三年「更显著」增加。
ADR 当天下跌 2.3%，次日收盘累计跌约 5%，资本开支上调和第三季毛利率走低盖过了亮眼业绩。7 月下旬芯片股抛售令其在 7 月 29 日跌至 375 美元，较财报前收盘低约 11%。之后随 AI 需求稳健稳步回升，10 月初升至约 486 美元的高位，目前仍较财报前高约 8%。

bio.en: Yale PhD in electrical engineering who joined TSMC in 1998 from Chartered Semiconductor. Co-CEO from 2013, CEO since 2018 and chairman since 2024; steering the 2nm ramp and new fabs in Arizona, Japan and Germany.
bio.zh: 耶鲁大学电子工程博士，1998 年从特许半导体加入台积电。2013 年任共同执行长，2018 年起任总裁（CEO），2024 年起兼任董事长；主导 2 纳米量产及美国亚利桑那、日本、德国新厂建设。

bio.en: CFO and spokesperson since September 2019, after serving as deputy CFO. Joined TSMC in 1999 and led major deals such as the acquisitions of TASMC and WSMC; earlier corporate finance roles at ING Barings, Chase Manhattan and Bankers Trust.
bio.zh: 2019 年 9 月由副财务长升任财务长兼发言人。1999 年加入台积电，主导收购德碁半导体与世大积体电路等重大交易；更早任职于 ING 霸菱、大通银行和信孚银行的企业融资部门。
